items.html: And behold, if before the emergence of Adam HaRishon ZON were in the aspect of face to face, their backs would be exposed, and the Klipot would cling to them greatly. Therefore, in order that the Klipot not cling to their backs, they had to adhere back to back with a truly complete adhesion, from the Chazeh of ZA downward, as is known. And then, by this, the Klipot cannot enter between them to cling there to their backs; and behold, all the back of the female is covered, but the back of the male, from the Chazeh upward, was exposed.
